title: Why the World’s Best Mathematicians Are Hoarding Chalk
summary: A short Great Big Story piece about Hagoromo, a Japanese chalk brand so prized that mathematicians stockpiled it, with some reportedly dealing it on the side. It tells the quirky tale of a writing tool whose supply became scarce.
why: Cited as an amusing side story whenever HN discusses blackboards, chalk, and how mathematicians work.

quote.text: Pretty amusing they were stockpiling it and some were chalk dealers on the side.
